title: bluepave platform configuration (bluepave.yaml)
description: Everything an adopter decides about their platform. Nothing here is secret; discovered IDs live in .bluepave/discovered.yaml.

name.description: The platform's name, shown in the portal and used in descriptions.

prefix.description: Short prefix for every Azure resource name (rg-<prefix>-<env>-<region>-<role>). Lowercase letters and digits, 2-5 characters, so derived names stay within Azure limits.

profile.description: Preset for sizing and features: trial (fits an Azure Free Trial), standard, production.

region.description: Azure region name, e.g. eastasia, westeurope.

environments.description: Clusters to create. dev hosts the dev and staging stages; prod is its own cluster.

domain.description: A domain you own. Apps get <app>.<env>.<domain>; the zone is created in Azure DNS and you delegate it at your registrar.

owner.description: GitHub user or organisation owning the platform and app repositories.

platformRepo.description: This repository's name (created from the bluepave template).

appName.description: Name of the platform's GitHub App, created by `bluepave up`. Default: <owner>-<metadata.name>.

group.description: Entra ID group of platform admins: cluster admins, portal users, Kargo promoters. Created if missing.

modules.description: Turn modules on or off, and override their settings. Unlisted modules use the profile's default.

moduleSources.description: Extra module repositories (third-party modules), loaded after the built-in modules.

ref.description: A tag or commit, never a branch.
